description: Generate a random secret string for a rotation job. Rotation-function API (Secret Rotate Process Control): meant to be called by the rotation trigger's function with the job token it receives, not during normal administration. ⚠️ The response contains the secret value in plain text.

excludeCharacters.description: Characters to exclude (one string, no separator)

jobToken.description: Rotation job token (injected into the rotation function's environment; also in ncloud_secret_get_secret_logs)

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

length.description: Length of the random string (5-32, default 12)

requireEachIncludedType.description: Require every non-excluded character type to appear (default true)

name: ncloud_secret_job_generate_random_secret
